Tesseract.js 6.0.1 / core 6.0.0 / eng 1.0.0

Official npm packages were SHA-512 integrity-checked before extraction. Only browser SDK, worker, four official embedded WebAssembly variants and eng 4.0.0 (Legacy model) are hosted here. The short mixed letter/digit labels use the Legacy classifier with dictionaries disabled; the expected worksheet ID is never supplied. Recognition runs locally in a Web Worker. All worker/core/language URLs are explicitly set to this directory; no image is sent to an OCR service. The worker is terminated after the two label crops.

Sources: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js ; https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core ; https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
